Playwright Chronicles: Crafting Elegant Automation in JS/TS from Scratch — Part 37: Playwright Config Secrets with Capture Screenshots, Videos & Traces Effortlessly

4 min read
2 hours ago

--

In this post, it will explore how Playwright makes it effortless to capture screenshots, videos and traces by simply configuring a few key‑value pairs inside the playwright config file. With these settings, you can decide whether to record artifacts only when tests fail, for every test run or not at all, giving you full control over debugging and storage.
Capturing Screenshots via Playwright Config
Playwright provides a powerful way to configure screenshot behavior globally through the ‘playwright.config.ts’ file. By setting the screenshot property inside the use object, you can control when and how screenshots are captured during test execution.
On Test Failure
Captures screenshots only when a test fails. Ideal for CI pipelines where you want artifacts for debugging but don’t need screenshots for passing tests.
use: {
browserName: 'chromium', // Browser to run tests in
headless: false, // Run in headed mode for visibility
screenshot: 'only-on-failure' // Capture screenshots only when tests fail
},
